messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Malayalam, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Malayalam line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
അവൾ എന്നെ അത്രയധികം ഭാരമുണ്ടാക്കി അവളുടെ ദർശനത്തിൽ നിന്നു ഉദിച്ച ഭയത്തോടുകൂടി, ഞാൻ ഉയരത്തിന്റെ പ്രതീക്ഷ നഷ്ടപ്പെട്ടു.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition (from Step 1) | Target Word / Phrase (Malayalam) | Back‑Translation (English) | Status | |-------------|--------------------------------------|----------------------------------|-----------------------------|--------| | **questa** | Demonstrative pronoun, fem. sg., subject – “she” | അവൾ | she | OK | | **mi** | Clitic dative pronoun, 1st sg. – “me” | എന്നെ | me (object) | OK | | **porse** | Verb 3sg remote past of *porre* “to cause” – “caused” | ഉണ്ടാക്കി | caused / made | OK | | **tanto** | Adverb of quantity – “so much” | അത്രയധികം | so much | OK | | **di** (1) | Preposition “of” linking *gravezza* | — (omitted) | — | UNNECESSARY | | **gravezza** | Noun “heaviness” – the affective state | ഭാരം | heaviness / weight | OK | | **con** | Preposition “with” – introduces accompanying circumstance | …തോടുകൂടി | with … | OK | | **la** (1) | Definite article “the” (fem.) | — (omitted) | — | UNNECESSARY | | **paura** | Noun “fear” | ഭയം | fear | OK | | **ch'uscia** | Relative clause verb “that came out” | ഉദിച്ച | that came out | OK | | **di** (2) | Preposition “from” – source of the fear | നിന്നു | from | OK | | **sua** | Possessive adjective “her” | അവളുടെ | her | OK | | **vista** | Noun “sight” | ദർശനത്തിൽ | sight (in) | OK | | **ch'io** | Relative pronoun + subject “that I” | ഞാൻ | I | OK | | **perdei** | Verb 1sg remote past of *perdere* “to lose” – “lost” | നഷ്ടപ്പെട്ടു | lost | OK | | **la** (2) | Definite article “the” (fem.) | — (omitted) | — | UNNECESSARY | | **speranza** | Noun “hope” | പ്രതീക്ഷ | hope | OK | | **de** | Preposition “of” – links *speranza* to its content | യുടെ | of (genitive) | OK | | **l'altezza** | Noun “height” (metaphoric “lofty goal”) | ഉയരം | height | OK |
---
### Items Requiring Attention - **UNNECESSARY**: - `di` (first) – the Italian “of” is not expressed in Malayalam. - `la` (first) – the definite article is omitted in Malayalam. - `la` (second) – same reason as above.
No **MISSING**, **WRONG**, or **GRAMMAR** issues were detected; all retained elements agree in gender, number, and case with Malayalam grammatical norms.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Malayalam script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Malayalam text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).
